description: A simple overview of the most important Docker host and container metrics. (cAdvisor/Prometheus)

targets.expr: max by(nodename) ((max by (instance) ((node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!="tmpfs",  fstype!="vfat", device!="snapfuse"} - node_filesystem_free_bytes{fstype!="tmpfs",  fstype!="vfat", device!="snapfuse"} )/ node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!="tmpfs",  fstype!="vfat", device!="snapfuse"})) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"${server:regex}"})

max by(nodename) ((((node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{} - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{}) / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{}) * 100) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"${server:regex}"})
max by(nodename) ((node_load1{} / count by(job, instance)(count by(job, instance, cpu)(node_cpu_seconds_total{}))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"${server:regex}"})
max by(nodename) ((node_load1{} / count by(job, instance)(count by(job, instance, cpu)(node_cpu_seconds_total{}))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"${server:regex}"})
node_load1{instance="node-exporter"} / count by(job, instance)(count by(job, instance, cpu)(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance=~"node-exporter"}))
max by(nodename) (sum by(instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{} - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"${server:regex}"})

sum(max by (device, instance) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!="tmpfs",  fstype!="vfat", device!="snapfuse"} - node_filesystem_free_bytes{fstype!="tmpfs",  fstype!="vfat",  device!="snapfuse"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"${server:regex}"})
sum(max by (device, instance) (node_filesystem_free_bytes{fstype!="tmpfs",  fstype!="vfat",  device!="snapfuse"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"${server:regex}"})

sum(max by (device, instance) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!="tmpfs",  fstype!="vfat", device!="snapfuse"} - node_filesystem_free_bytes{fstype!="tmpfs",  fstype!="vfat",  device!="snapfuse"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~"${server:regex}"})
